sloka: धर्मार्थगुण सम्पन्नम् हरीश्वरमनुत्तमम् ।अधिक्षिप्तस्तदा रामः पश्चात् वालिनम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-१८-३॥
transliteration: dharmārthaguṇa sampannam harīśvaramanuttamam ।adhikṣiptastadā rāmaḥ paścāt vālinam abravīt ॥4-18-3॥

translations.english: To righteous Vali,the best of the monkeys, the lord of the monkeys, who looked like the Sun shorn of his brilliance or a raindrained cloud or a fire that had been extinguished. Rama, under the scanner, said in reply:
translations.hindi: इतने में तारा ने सुना कि, वानरश्रेष्ठ बालि युद्ध भें श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के शराघात से मारा गया
